assets.purpose: Compare diagram: Hard, soft, and directional value (wide layout).
assets.license: Original diagram authored for this course; no third-party elements
assets.alt: A comparison of three kinds of value with how each is treated: hard-dollar value, which changes a budget line and can be counted; soft-dollar value, which creates capacity that must be redeployed to count; and directional value, which is real but not yet monetized.
